edits.old: Then they carry identifiers, list values, court references, dates and amounts only
edits.new:
Then they carry identifiers, list values, court references, dates and amounts only

  Scenario: AC7 The appeal is one legal action row of this service, and its court references, claim amount and filing facts are written on that row only (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the appeal is decided, approved and filed
    When the appeal facts are written
    Then the court references, the claim amount and the filing facts are written on the legal action row and nowhere else

  Scenario: AC8 A request with no valid credential, no Litigation right or an out-of-scope case is answered 401, 403 or 404 and nothing is written (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a provided operation of this service is called
    When the caller has no valid credential, lacks the Litigation right, or names a case or legal action outside its scope
    Then the answer is 401, 403 or 404 as section 5 gives, and nothing is written

  Scenario: AC9 A retried or timed-out hand-off is re-run with the same Idempotency-Key and writes once (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the approval, the case or the partner contract does not answer inside 2 s
    When the hand-off is retried with the same Idempotency-Key
    Then the legal action keeps what it wrote and the hand-off is written once

  Scenario: AC10 A consumed call that fails or does not answer leaves the legal action with what it wrote (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-decision, rwb-case or rwb-partner contract mock fails or does not answer
    When the call is made
    Then the answer is 503 with the platform error envelope and the legal action keeps what it wrote

  Scenario: AC11 A status change the model does not allow is refused and nothing changes (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the legal action is not in a status from which the requested change is allowed
    When the change is requested
    Then the answer is 409 as exception X3 gives and nothing changes
